text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What matters most is pushing oneself to 
burn at the absolute limit. In her 
showdown against Hokko Tarumae, Wonder 
Acute came to realize that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a major change of heart, she readily 
accepted the rematch. She now sets her 
sights on her next stage: the Champions 
Cup.
